basic_details.job_title: GMCH Chandigarh Lab Technician Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Biochemistry, Government Medical College & Hospital (GMCH), Chandigarh, has invited applications for one Lab Technician post in the project "Establishment of DBT NIDAN KENDRA", purely on a temporary basis under Dr Shivani Jaswal (Principal Investigator). The application form with self-attested documents must be submitted in the Department of Biochemistry, Block-E, Level-4, GMCH, Sector 32, Chandigarh, latest by 23 November 2026, 5.00 p.m.

content_sections.heading: About the GMCH Chandigarh DBT NIDAN KENDRA Project
content_sections.text: Government Medical College and Hospital is located in Sector 32, Chandigarh. The post is in the project "Establishment of DBT NIDAN KENDRA", run by the Department of Biochemistry under Dr Shivani Jaswal, Professor & Head and Principal Investigator. The notice says the project involves lab work, sample collection and data analysis.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates should apply with the attached application form and all self-attested supportive documents/testimonials. They must submit them latest by 23/11/2026, 5.00 p.m. at: Department of Biochemistry, Dr. Shivani Jaswal, Professor & Head, Principal Investigator, Block-E, Level-4, GMCH, Sector 32, Chandigarh. The application form is given at the end of the notice. It asks for the applicant's name, father's name, date of birth, age, gender, complete residential address, mobile number and email ID. It also asks for education details (degree, college, university, marks %, attempt) and work experience (post, place of work, from and to dates, work profile). The applicant gives the date, place and signature, and attaches self-attested copies of the required certificates. The notice does not mention a postal mode or an email address for sending the application.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: BSc MLT / DMLT with 1 years' experience in a recognized organization as a Lab technician. Desirable experience: experience of lab work in the field of molecular analysis. Age limit: Upto 35 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for age and no age relaxation. Period of engagement: from the date of appointment till the remaining period of the project. Nature of appointment: purely on contract basis, temporary in nature. If a candidate is working somewhere, an NOC from the concerned Department of the Institute is needed. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: GMCH Chandigarh Lab Technician Job Description
content_sections.text: The project involves lab work/sample collection and data analysis. The appointed staff may have to work in emergency situations, field visits and travel outstation.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Filled application form (form given at the end of the notice) Date of Birth Certificate (self-attested copy) Essential qualification certificates (self-attested copy) Experience certificate if any (self-attested copy) NOC, if applicable Passport size Photo

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of higher educational qualification, work experience and/or a screening test, if required. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview/written test. Meeting the essential qualification/experience does not guarantee a call for interview. The date of the interview/test will be intimated through email only. No separate letter for the screening test/interview will be issued individually. The notice advises candidates to keep in continuous contact with the GMCH website ( www.gmch.gov.in , www.gmch.nic.in ) for all related updates. The validity of the waiting list is one year.

faq.question: Q1. How many Lab Technician posts are vacant at GMCH Chandigarh?
faq.answer: There is one Lab Technician post, in the project "Establishment of DBT NIDAN KENDRA" under the Department of Biochemistry.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GMCH Chandigarh Lab Technician?
faq.answer: The application form and self-attested documents must be submitted latest by 23 November 2026, 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the GMCH Chandigarh Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is BSc MLT / DMLT with 1 years' experience in a recognized organization as a Lab technician. Experience of lab work in the field of molecular analysis is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The age limit is Upto 35 years. The notice prints no age relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Lab Technician at GMCH Chandigarh?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs 20000/- pm + HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for GMCH Chandigarh Lab Technician?
faq.answer: Fill in the attached application form and submit it with self-attested documents to the Department of Biochemistry, Dr. Shivani Jaswal, Block-E, Level-4, GMCH, Sector 32, Chandigarh, by 23 November 2026, 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted on higher educational qualification, work experience and/or a screening test, if required. Only shortlisted candidates are called for the interview/written test, and the date will be intimated through email only.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on contract basis, temporary in nature, from the date of appointment till the remaining period of the project. It gives no right to regular appointment or permanent absorption.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid either for appearing in the interview or for joining the post.
